Name: WispUI
Author: NennMichSchinken
Punchline: A curated UI suite for FFXIV.
Description: WispUI is a focused, curated UI suite for Final Fantasy XIV. It keeps the game's own party list and adds cleanse and raise marks and mouseover casting to it, and brings Quick Dispel, a damage meter with skill details fed by IINACT, a slidecast window on the cast bar and a ring round the mouse pointer. The option list is short on purpose.
